basis: Both are Churchill's 'The River War: An Historical Account of the Reconquest of the Soudan' (Longmans, ed. Col. F. Rhodes). river_war.txt is the 1902 New and Revised single-volume edition; 81282 is Vol. I of the original two-volume edition (Osmania Univ. scan, accession OU 218483; its sibling 81283 is Vol. II). Same work, different edition/volume — same_work.

All four are Winston Churchill's 'The World Crisis' series but different publications with different content: 206774 = The World Crisis 1916-1918 Part II (Viceregal/President's Secretariat scan); 41900 = The World Crisis 1911-1918, Abridged and Revised one-volume edition; worldcrisis0004unse = The World Crisis Volume IV (Scribner's, 1927); worldcrisis00chur = The World Crisis Vol. I 'First Lord of the Admiralty 1911 to 1915' (Macmillan Canada, 1923). Distinct volumes/editions — all pairs distinct.

Both are Volume II of Churchill's 'The River War' two-volume edition (Longmans, Green & Co., IN TWO VOLUMES / VOLUME II, ed. Col. F. Rhodes, ill. Angus McNeill). 81283 = Osmania Univ. scan (OU 218482); 106285 = Asiatic Society of Bombay scan (Dewey 962.403). Same work, same volume, different scans — same_work.

Both are Churchill's only novel 'Savrola: A Tale of the Revolution in Laurania': savrolaatalerev00churgoog = Google Books scan; savrolataleofrev0000chur = Internet Archive scan (Trent University, 2019). Same novel, different scans — same_work.
